files.note: The reference grunt. Hunched slab torso on two reverse-jointed stilt legs, backpack core pod, forearm blades, one visor slit. Every other enemy is read against this silhouette.

Swarm chaff — instantly "the small one". A faceted pod on three jointed legs, tri-petal jaw around a single lens, dorsal fins, amber sac underneath. Scatters 2.8 m across the path so it reads as spray, not a line.
A walking wall. The 2.4 m slab is the mechanic — it physically occludes sightlines — so the front is a tiled plate field and everything mechanical (spine, rams, core) hangs off the back.

Must read airborne at distance: a flat delta hull with glass canopy, twin belly thrusters, V-tail, and wings on `skiff_wing_l/r` pivots with hinge pods and split ailerons. Origin is the hull underside; the sim supplies altitude.

Directional armour you answer by moving. Three banded 140° shield plates on struts across the front; the rear is an open cage of coolant pipes around a glowing weak core. Four jointed legs, low and braced.

Body only — the bubble is `enemy_warden_shield.glb`, a separate mesh that pops and regrows independently. A finned shield generator on the back feeds three coiled emitter masts on the shoulder ring, so the shield has an obvious source.

Separate bubble mesh, origin at the Warden's feet so it drops in at the same transform. Faceted translucent field with three seam rings and hex contact nodes where the emitter masts touch it; scale 1→0 on pop.
Low, long, obviously the one that goes under: three overlapping shell segments, a fluted drill on `mole_drill` (spin it), triple-claw digging arms, flank vents, and soil still packed in the plates.

Dirt mound with the drill tip just breaking through, cracked ground plates lifted around it, and the tremor trail behind (+Z, since it travels −Z) as ridged soil with thrown clods. The enemy is invisible; the ground is not.

Visibly gravid: five Mote sacs bulge through the carapace behind clamp rings, a dorsal ridge runs over the belly, and a mandibled head hangs low. Four spindly jointed legs keep the belly the silhouette so the split is telegraphed.
Tips just proud of the plate: a threat you can see but a Mote might not.
Spikes fully extended, hazard glowing — the burst frame.
Retracted, lamps off. Three charges gone; reads as safe until rearmed.
A deep dark pool with a chill-blue rim. Wet = active.
Thin cracked residue, rim dark. Same footprint so players learn the shape.
Piston primed, pad raised a hand, buff-orange charge ring lit.
Pad thrown to full extension and tilted down-route (+Z): the recoil frame.
Pad flat, ring dark, hazard lamps only. Reads as "not yet".

The starter, never taken away. A compact service pistol: serrated slide, exposed hammer, round-count lamp on the slide, and a full 7-slot rail set so even the free gun is a build.

Hitscan priority tool. Long fluted barrel with gas block, slotted handguard, charging handle, curved magazine and a full stock. The mark alt-fire is telegraphed by the designator lamp above the ejection port.
Pump-action panic weapon for the perch. Fat bore, perforated heat shield, tube magazine under the barrel, ribbed pump, side saddle of brass shells, and a short stock with a thick recoil pad.
The shooter's half of Thermal Shock. A fuel-fed hand cannon: glowing ember canister behind the frame, braided hose, finned vented shroud, pilot flame at the muzzle and a thermal gauge on the slide.

Powered repair wrench: long rubber-wrapped handle, adjustable jaw with a worm gear, a compact drive motor with cooling slots, hazard band, and a repair-status lamp that reads green when a structure is topped up. Origin at the grip.

Base gloved forearms; pose per platform (weapon.handsPose): rifle two-hand,  pistol cup, tool grip. Rifle pose: right hand closed on the grip at the origin, left hand forward under the handguard. Segmented finger boxes, knuckle plates, wrist cuffs and rolled sleeves; faction variants swap the plates.

World-space name-tag plate: chamfered dark plate with a brass rule, faction chip on the left (tint at runtime via `nameplate_chip`), HP bar track and fill (`nameplate_hp` scale X), and a hanging pin to the head. Text is a runtime label on `nameplate_text`.

Tileable slag ground: 10×10 displaced grid, relief ±0.15 m, flat edges so tiles seam. Instance on a 20 m grid under the whole 110×80 playfield; the roadway kit sits 6 cm above it. Boulders and lava cracks are `foundry_terrain_scatter`, placed clear of routes and sockets.
Slag boulder cluster with a cooled-lava crack seam. Scatter these by hand in levels.js, never within 2.5 m of a route, socket or placed piece.
One 4 m run of the 3.4 m-wide ground lane: two cast-iron plates, riveted, with a centre drain seam and worn tread ridges; a kerb lip both sides so the lane reads as a channel from the deck.
One 4 m bay of the 28×10 m upper deck at y 5.8–6.0: grating panels between I-beam joists, rivet rows on the flanges, a service lamp under the edge. Instance 7 along X at x −12…12 (centre x 2, z −17).
One 4 m run of deck rail: two posts, top rail, mid rail, kick plate and a hazard band. Sits on the deck's +Z edge at z −12.2. Open bays where the ladder and zipline anchor land.
Riveted box-section column with a flared cap plate and base plinth, rust streaks as dark bands, a conduit run up one face.
The hero-only shortcut under the deck: corrugated duct walls, roof ribs, grated floor strip, warm lamps every 3.5 m, hazard lips at both mouths. Mount `shared_vent_grate` at each end.
Refractory brick wall with a steel cap rail, buttresses every 5 m, a slag chute stain, and one furnace window glowing molten. Repeat around the 110×80 m playfield.
Inverted 400 m dome: deep obsidian zenith with an ember-orange horizon band, a distant stack silhouette ring, and a slag-cloud ceiling. GLB stand-in for the HDR.
Tilting crucible on a trunnion frame with a molten surface, pour lip, slag crust rim and a drip. The map's biggest light source — place away from route sightlines.
Overhead pipe rack: three lines of differing gauge on two goalpost supports, flanges, a bypass elbow, two wheel valves and a pressure gauge. Runs along X.

Overhead travelling crane: two lattice legs, a box girder, trolley with a chain block and hook, hazard-striped end stops, cab with a lit window. Spans the yard at 9 m — clear of the 8 m air lane only where placed off-route.
Yard floodlight mast: lattice pole, cross-arm with four hooded flood heads, junction box, ladder rungs and a hazard collar. Point heads down-route to justify the level lighting.
Floor vent: recessed grate in a riveted collar, a stub stack with a flap lid propped open, steam plume stand-in, scorch ring. Safe filler along the lane edges — it never rises above 1.5 m.

Tileable ballast ground with two disused sidings embedded along X and a drainage channel. Tiles seam flat. The "three tiers" of the brief are the yard (0 m), mid deck (5 m) and catwalk (10 m) structures placed on top.
Stacked spare sleepers, a spoil heap and a loose rail length. Scatter in the margins only.

One 4 m run of the freight cut the shortcut route uses: track at grade, 1.2 m concrete kerb walls with weep pipes and cap rails, ballast embankments outside them, catenary-style lamp post. Floor stays at y 0 — b1/t2/t4 sit on it. Place only where no other route or socket crosses (x −18…−10).
One 4 m run of the 3.4 m ground lane: packed ballast, a single track down the centre, sleeper kerbs and mile-marker posts so the lane reads as the yard's main line.
Precast concrete panel wall with steel soldier piles, a cap beam with a chain-link fence, rust-streaked drainage scuppers and a stencilled yard marker plate. Doubles as the map perimeter.

One 4 m bay of the 24×8 m mid deck at y 5: riveted plate-girder edges, chequer-plate floor, a trestle bent (two raked legs + cross brace) per bay, rust weathering. Guard rail on the +Z edge with an opening at the ladder bay.

One 4 m bay of the 22×5 m catwalk at y 10: open grating, tube handrails both sides with mesh infill, angle-iron trusses under, a hanging floodlight. Legs are the separate lattice columns at x −6 and 12. Sockets w3/w4 sit here — the only ones that see the whole air strand.
Riveted lattice column for the catwalk (and, at half height, the mid-deck support pillar). Concrete plinth, four angle chords with zigzag lacing, a cap plate.
Night yard: near-black zenith, sodium-orange horizon band, distant gantry and water-tower silhouettes. GLB stand-in for the HDR.
Rusted boxcar on two bogies: corrugated sides, sliding door ajar, roof walk, ladder, brake wheel, buffers and coupler. Big enough to occlude — only on sidings the sockets do not look across.
Corrugated 6 m shipping container with corner castings, twist-lock pads, door bars and a faded ID plate. Rotate/stack pairs to build sightline-safe backdrops along the perimeter.

Colour-light signal gantry: lattice mast, two signal heads with hoods (red over green), a relay cabinet at the foot, access ladder with cage, and a number plate. Red head marks the freight cut when b1 is built.
Rail-built buffer stop: two raked rail struts, a hazard-painted beam with twin buffer heads, sleeper cribbing and a red marker lamp. Terminates each disused siding.
Fixed-height 6 m ladder (Switchyard's 5 m / 5.4 m ladders scale Y). Bolted wall flanges every 1.5 m so it reads as attached, not leaning.
Post with a top sheave at 1.6 m — the cable leaves from `zip_sheave`. Brass lamp is the interact prompt anchor.
Unit-length twisted cable along −Z with a clamp at each end; the client scales Z to the anchor distance.
Twin-wheel trolley with a hanging T-bar handle and a brake lever; origin at the cable line.
Pad flush, buff-orange chevrons dim: waiting.
Pad raised 30 cm on the piston, chevrons lit, ring glowing — you are on it.
Pad at full 1 m throw with the piston extended and steam ports open.
Tunnel-mouth frame with a hinged bar grate swung open, warning lamp and hazard lip — marks the hero-only shortcut.
Pad with a dark pylon and a hollow ring: nobody home.
Ring lit in a partial arc (240°), pylon lamps climbing, relay dish raised halfway.
Full ring, all lamps, relay dish up and pointed at the bonus socket.

Vending-machine armory: brass-trimmed cabinet with a display rack of three weapon silhouettes, a workbench lip, ammo drawers, an overhead sign lamp and a ground floodlight ring so it can be found from the yard.
A 4 m containment sphere in a gantry ring on a stepped plinth, four coolant stacks, gate arches on the route side. Big enough to read from spawn.
Breach frame: containment ring cracked open, arcs leaking, warning lamps red.
A 4 m blast-door arch with the door irised half-open, threat-red inner glow, siren stacks on the piers, rubble skirt. Sits over the route's first waypoint facing +X along the lane.

Lattice mast carrying the visible air-lane strand: cyan beacon ring at the top, guy-wire eyelets, a hazard collar at 2 m. Place one per air waypoint; the strand mesh is a client spline between beacons.
Ring-lit plate: buildable. Green scan ring, four ticks.
Same plate with the tower mount collar, clamps and a power feed — the tower chassis sits on `_mount`.
Deck-edge plate with a stanchion so it reads as an elevated socket; rail-blue ring.
Deck-edge plate with mount collar and stanchion.
Octagonal plate flush with the path, fuse-gold ring — a trap goes here.
Threat-red ring with a hazard band across the cut: the barricade lesson.

The M1 showpiece: a frost shell shattering outward as a fire core detonates through it. Frost shards fly out on `_pulse`, the ember ring expands, steam cones rise. Ember and frost both present so the co-op combo is legible.
A column of ice locking the target: hex-prism ice pillar with an inner magenta discharge frozen mid-arc, frost crystals bursting from the base ring. The pillar is `_fade`; arcs are `_spin`.
Flame tongues licking up around the body on `_rise`, an ember ring at the feet, a smoke wisp from the shoulders. Flames lean with the target's travel (−Z) so movement reads.
Frost rime crusting the lower body: ice crystal spikes from the feet, drifting hex flakes on `_spin`, a slow frost ring, and a translucent cold shell that reads as a speed penalty rather than a stop.
Magenta arcs crawling over the body between three orbit nodes on `_spin`, a ground discharge ring, a short vertical strike. Brief and loud — it is a stagger, not a lock.
Armour plates flaking off the target: steel chips orbiting outward on `_pulse`, exposed-seam glow lines, sparks at the feet, a cracked-plate ring. Reads as "hit it now".
Priority-target reticle: a gold bracket ring hovering over the head on `_spin`, a diamond pin, a thin ground ring, and a light column so the team sees the mark through crowds.
The Warden bubble bursting: hex shards flying outward on `_pulse`, a bright equatorial ring, a residual half-shell fading on `_fade`.
The bubble regrowing from the emitter masts: three rising seam arcs on `_rise`, a partial lower shell filling upward, hex motes converging on `_pulse`, teal ring at the feet.
Dirt fountain: a dark soil cone with clods flung outward on `_pulse`, a dust dome on `_fade`, torn ground plates, and the fissure ring the burrowed mesh continues.
The Cluster bursting: five amber sac shells arcing outward to the Mote landing ring on `_pulse`, membrane strands, a carapace shard burst, amber flash at the belly height.
Alarm hit on the core: threat-red shockwave ring on `_pulse`, a vertical warning column, arcs jumping off the gantry, a crack flash at the sphere, four siren cones. Sized to the 6 m core.

The hold-R channel: a green light column over the downed hero, a progress ring filling on `_pulse` (arc = progress), rising motes on `_rise`, and a hand-to-chest tether line from the reviver origin 0.6 m in front.

Forge's builder surge: a 10 m gold ground ring with gear-tooth ticks on `_spin`, a low dome on `_fade`, radial power conduits from the hero, and a per-tower crown ring (`overdrive_tower_crown`, place on each buffed tower at chassis height).

Ember's aim-point wave: an expanding 6 m fire ring on `_pulse` with flame crests, a scorched ground disc, a directional splash cone from the hero toward the aim point (−Z), and embers rising on `_rise`.
Tempest's AoE burst: a central strike pillar, six radial chain bolts to hit-point nodes on `_spin`, a 7 m magenta ring on `_pulse`, ground scorch spokes. Pair with chill for Flash Freeze columns.
Construction flash on the 2.1 m pad: a green holo-cage of the chassis volume on `_fade`, corner clamps dropping on `_rise`, a pad ring on `_pulse`, sparks.
Deconstruction: the chassis volume dissolving into brass scrap cubes rising on `_rise`, a refund coin-column, the pad ring collapsing on `_pulse`. Warm brass so it reads as money back, not damage.

Level-up: three arcane-teal chevrons climbing the chassis on `_rise`, a bright cap ring at the new module height on `_pulse`, a light column, data-tick rings. The chevron count (1–3) can be culled per tier.
Portal opening beat: a threat-red shock ring rolling down the lane on `_pulse`, the iris glow flaring, siren cones sweeping on `_spin`, ground chevrons pointing +X along the route.
All-clear beat: green success rings rising off the core on `_rise`, a fountain of scrap-bounty motes on `_pulse`, four upward light beams from the stacks, a calm ground ring.
Replaces the stock barrel: 42 cm fluted tube with a gas block and a target crown. Carries `attach_mount_muzzle` at its end.
Chopped 16 cm barrel in a ported shroud: reads as a snub the moment it is mounted. `attach_mount_muzzle` at the end.
Muzzle device with four upward gas ports and three side slots; chamfered crown and index marks.
Rail-clamped optic: tubular body with objective and ocular glass, a laser emitter under the tube, elevation dial, and a green readout window on the left.
Replaces the magazine: ribbed drum with a feed tower, spring-tension dial, and a viewing window showing the coiled brass.
Skeleton brace: twin struts on an adjustable tube, a T-pad with rubber, locking lever and sling loop. Replaces any factory stock; fits pistols too.
Gravium counter-mass under the barrel: a dense block in a rail cradle with two gyro rings and a violet field slit. Heavy, and it should look heavy.
Infusion cell: a brass-wound coil around a glowing ember core, heat fins on the outboard face and a hose stub into the receiver.
Infusion cell: a pressure canister with a frost-blue sight window, bleed valve and rime rings, clamped to the receiver.
Infusion cell: a boxy capacitor with two electrodes and a visible arc gap glowing magenta, charge stripe along the side.
Brass case, plain jacketed tip; pale-gold tracer. Magazine block with the top round exposed plus a loose round for the armory grid.
Black penetrator tip with a steel band; thin white-hot tracer. Magazine block with the top round exposed plus a loose round for the armory grid.
Dimpled cavity tip and amber band; wide orange tracer that reads as a mushrooming hit. Magazine block with the top round exposed plus a loose round for the armory grid.
Ember-glass tip; tracer trails flame petals. Magazine block with the top round exposed plus a loose round for the armory grid.
Frost-blue tip; tracer sheds ice crystals. Magazine block with the top round exposed plus a loose round for the armory grid.
